quote: Controlling response length in large language models (LLMs) is critical for efficient deployment... This work establishes extreme value theory as a principled framework for modeling LLM verbosity patterns in question-answering tasks across architectures.
Our analysis focuses on English question‑answering tasks using the HotpotQA dataset...

We analyzed 14,301 English question-answer pairs from the HotpotQA test set under controlled conditions to investigate (1) the statistical modeling of LLM output word counts, and (2) the impact of anchored prompts and temperature on LLM response characteristics.
Model selection via maximum likelihood estimation used both Akaike information criterion (AIC) and root-mean-square error (RMSE)... achieving unprecedented tail fit accuracy (R 2 CDF = 0.9993).
